stories.title: Sources: No real progress in Mayfield, Bucs talks
stories.summary: The Buccaneers and Baker Mayfield have not made significant progress on a new contract as the quarterback's stated deadline for a new deal approaches, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Simms: Shanahan nearly lost eye in car crash
stories.summary: Kyle Shanahan nearly lost an eye as a result of his car crash earlier this month, according to Chris Simms, who is close friends with the 49ers coach.

stories.title: Three-time Pro Bowler Adams, 30, to join Vikings
stories.summary: Three-time Pro Bowler and 2017 first-round pick Jamal Adams, 30, agreed to join the Minnesota Vikings, the 10-year NFL standout said on social media Monday, a season after playing for the Las Vegas Raiders, when he converted from safety to linebacker.
